_comment: Scenario battery for Speeding Health's Node 2 (claude-haiku-4-5). Created 2026-09-02 when LOCATION_RULE was switched from the fleet-default 'This clinic has ONE location. NEVER ask the caller about location.' to the modern 'NEVER ask location in Node 2. Node 3 handles all location disambiguation.' pattern (matches adaptive_chiropractic/village_remedies). Confirmed via DB this clinic genuinely has 2 active bookable locations -- Speeding Health (main) and Clockhouse Court, St Albans -- with the same practitioner (Glen Chesterton) working both on different days/hours, contradicting the old 'ONE location' wording against node_3_availability_handler.txt's 2-entry location_id_map. See scripts/node2_configs.py CLINIC_CONFIGS['speeding_health']['slots']['LOCATION_RULE'] and .claude/rules/node-edit-verification.md.

scenarios.name: sports-massage-no-location-ask-in-node-2

history.content: I'd like to book a Sports Massage with Glen please, I've been before.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if Node 2 never asks which location the caller wants and, once the branch's gate/variant question(s) resolve, calls universal_router intent="confirm_service" without a location question anywhere in this node -- location disambiguation is left entirely to Node 3. FAIL if the agent asks 'which location' or any variant of it in this node.

scenarios.name: clockhouse-volunteered-captured-silently

history.content: Can I book a Clinical Therapy session at Clockhouse Court please, I've been before.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent does NOT echo or confirm the location back to the caller ('Got it, Clockhouse Court' is forbidden per LOCATION-ONLY GUARD), captures it silently for the CONTEXT PIGGYBACK location field, and proceeds with the branch's normal gate/question flow with zero location-related spoken output. FAIL if the agent acknowledges or confirms the location, or asks the caller to restate/confirm it.
